Inquest into death of Sheffield United Cusack to resume next month
items.excerpt: An inquest into the death of Sheffield United midfielder Maddy Cusack will resume next month after there was a delay to obtain more information about her time at the club.
body: An inquest into the death of Sheffield United midfielder Maddy Cusack will resume next month after there was a delay to obtain more information about her time at the club.
Cusack's family sent a written complaint to United within a week after she died, outlining issues they alleged stemmed from her time working under her coach Jonathan Morgan.

The 27-year-old was found unresponsive at her home in Horsley, Derbyshire, on September 20 2023, after Morgan made comments about her weight and relationship with another player, Chesterfield Coroner's Court heard.

Assistant coroner Sophie Cartwright KC heard eight days of evidence from Morgan, Cusack's parents, her former team-mates, and members of staff from United, before the inquest was adjourned in July to get more evidence from the club.

items.title: Semenyo withdraws support for prosecution of Liverpool fan in racial abuse case
items.excerpt: A Liverpool fan accused of racially abusing Antoine Semenyo has been found not guilty after the Manchester City forward withdrew his support for the prosecution.
body: A Liverpool fan accused of racially abusing Antoine Semenyo has been found not guilty after the Manchester City forward withdrew his support for the prosecution.

Semenyo was due to give evidence at Liverpool Magistrates' Court on Friday in the trial of Mark Mogan, 47, who was accused of shouting abuse during the Premier League match between Liverpool and Semenyo's former club Bournemouth at Anfield on August 15 last year.

But Simon Jones, prosecuting, said: "Following recent contact made with Mr Semenyo, he has indicated he is no longer supportive of proceedings and the prosecution do not consider it is appropriate to compel him.
"In those circumstances we offer no further evidence in the case."

body: England have been given a suspended away ticket ban by UEFA for "racist and/or discriminatory behaviour" by their fans during the 3-2 win over Spain in Madrid.
The punishment is a one-match ban and is suspended for a "probationary period" of two years.
Sky Sports News understands the punishment is for anti-Catholic and anti-Irish chanting during the Nations League match.

items.title: Seven years on from the sack at Spurs what sort of coach is Pochettino now?
items.excerpt: What Mauricio Pochettino achieved with Tottenham Hotspur in the previous decade looks even more impressive now than it did at the time. Manchester United really should have turned to the popular Argentine coach years ago.
body: What Mauricio Pochettino achieved with Tottenham Hotspur in the previous decade looks even more impressive now than it did at the time. Manchester United really should have turned to the popular Argentine coach years ago.

In his five full seasons in charge, Spurs were in the Premier League's top five each time - a run that has never been bettered in their history. He took the club above Arsenal for the first time in a generation and into a Champions League final for the first time ever.

Silverware was missing, much to the amusement of his critics, but the charges against Manchester City serve as a reminder that he was playing with the deck stacked against him. He overachieved and it is his thrilling football that endures in the memory.
